title: Prime orbits and residue actions for a finite invariant quotient
statement:
Let $H$ be a finite group acting by ring automorphisms on a commutative ring $D$, and put $A=D^H=\{d\in D:h(d)=d\text{ for all }h\in H\}$. Then $D$ is integral over $A$: every element satisfies a monic polynomial over $A$. If $\mathfrak q\subset D$ is prime and $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak q\cap A$, every prime of $D$ contracting to $\mathfrak p$ is $h\mathfrak q$ for some $h\in H$. Write $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\operatorname{Frac}(A/\mathfrak p)$ and $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=\operatorname{Frac}(D/\mathfrak q)$. The field extension $\kappa(\mathfrak q)/\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-pc-field-extension] is algebraic and normal, meaning that the minimal polynomial of every element splits over $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$. The residue-action homomorphism
$$\{h\in H:h\mathfrak q=\mathfrak q\}\longrightarrow\operatorname{Aut}_{\kappa(\mathfrak p)}\kappa(\mathfrak q)$$
is surjective. No maximality of the primes, faithfulness of the action, Noetherian hypothesis, or separability of the residue extension is assumed.
